posts.title: What is a Digital Twin?
posts.description: What is a Network Digital Twin? Formally, a digital twin is a "virtual representation of a physical network" (https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-Y.3090-202202-I/en). However, in telecoms it is becoming more broadly known as the set of capabilities to automate network operations. posts.title: Complexity Kills Systems
posts.description: What is Chunking? Chunking refers to how our brains prefer to group information. Our working memory can hold about 3 pieces of information simultaneously, with the ability to stretch to 5. So our brain is pretty bad at handling lots of information at the same time.
